segment_summary.zh: 本段从带窗和淋浴装置的浴室淋浴区移动到双盆洗手台，随后经浴室门洞进入铺木地板、左侧有白色柜门的房间，并在 B 处转向或面向通往走廊的门洞；尚未确认已深入走廊。
segment_summary.en: In this segment the robot moved from the shower area with a window and shower fittings to the double-sink vanity, then passed through the bathroom doorway into a wood-floored room with white cabinet doors on the left, and at B turned toward or faced the doorway leading to the hallway; it is not yet confirmed that it has advanced down the hallway.

reason.zh: F26/F33 显示浴室门外木地板房间左侧为带黑色拉手的白色柜门，F34 显示视角已由白柜转向门洞，白柜仍在左侧，符合先进入白柜房间再转向走廊入口的当前要求；走廊内直行及后续地标尚未出现，不构成冲突。
reason.en: F26/F33 show that beyond the bathroom doorway is a wood-floored room with white cabinet doors with black handles on the left, and F34 shows the view turned from the white cabinets toward a doorway while the white cabinets remain on the left, consistent with the current requirement to enter the room with white cabinets and then turn toward the hallway entrance; walking down the hallway and later landmarks have not yet appeared, so there is no conflict.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Go through the doorway and enter the room with white cabinets on your left.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 穿过门洞，进入左侧有白色柜子的房间。

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Turn right to enter the hallway.
Walk straight down the hallway, passing an opening on your left and another on your right.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 沿走廊直行，经过左侧的一个开口和右侧的另一个开口。

description.zh: F5/F6 显示浴室淋浴区，F20 显示双盆洗手台，说明本段先从浴室内部移动到出口附近。
description.en: F5/F6 show the bathroom shower area and F20 shows the double-sink vanity, indicating movement within the bathroom toward the exit.

description.zh: F26 从浴室门口可见门外铺木地板、左侧为白色柜门的房间；F33 更接近该白色柜墙和墙边门洞。
description.en: F26 shows a wood-floored room beyond the bathroom doorway with white cabinet doors on the left; F33 is closer to that white cabinet wall and the adjacent doorway.

description.zh: F34 位于门洞前，左侧仍是白色柜门，右侧为深色大物体，前方为通向走廊的明亮开口；未见明确冲突。
description.en: F34 is in front of a doorway, with white cabinet doors still on the left, a large dark object on the right, and a bright opening ahead leading toward the hallway; no clear conflict is visible.

semantic_progress.zh: 截至 S02，已从有窗和淋浴设备的浴室经双盆洗手台走出浴室门洞，进入铺木地板且左侧为白色柜门的房间，并在门口转向或面向走廊入口；尚待在走廊内直行、经过左右开口、进入末端大开放房间并走到电视前。
semantic_progress.en: As of S02, the robot has moved from the bathroom with a window and shower fittings past the double-sink vanity, exited through the bathroom doorway into a wood-floored room with white cabinet doors on the left, and at the doorway turned toward or faced the hallway entrance; it still needs to walk down the hallway, pass the left and right openings, enter the large open room at the end, and reach the TV.
